test: npm run typecheck && npx vitest run <the test files you touched>
notes: The full suite is `npm test`: it runs through `aos heavy` with a worker cap, and every test temp dir lives under one per-run root that is removed afterwards. A run fails if it leaves anything in $TMPDIR.
Run targeted tests (`npx vitest run path/to/x.test.ts`) while you work; the full suite loads the machine.
The dev command above keeps the dev instance on its own port, database and tmux server: never run one against the real database or tmux.
A test instance must never reach the live one: the dev command unsets the AGENTOS_* variables; stop it with `npm run dev:stop` (never pkill by pattern).
Never stop or restart the AgentOS server you are running under; it ends your own session.
